title: Al-A'la 87:1-5 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-A'la, At-Tariq 1 to 8 and waqf
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-A'la 87:1-5 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 19. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى (١) ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ (٢) وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ (٣) وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ (٤) فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ (٥)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
And who brings out the pasture

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Hamzat al-wasl: the alif of ٱسْمَ is not said
Heavy letters خ and ق; natural madd
Full mouth; two counts on the end

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-A'la 87:1-5 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 87:1-5 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 87:1-5 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, box every laam of al- in 87:1 to 5 and write sun or moon.
Explain what happens to the pasture in 87:4 to 5 and what it teaches.
questions.a: Allah brings out green pasture, then turns it into dark, dry stubble: this world does not last.

questions.q: 87:2 to 3: Allah created, proportioned, destined and ...
questions.a: A) guided. 87:3: 'And who destined and [then] guided.'

questions.q: Think again: Al-A'la begins: 'Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High.' What do we already say in salah that does this?
questions.a: In sujud we say 'Subhana rabbiyal-a'la': glory be to my Lord, the Most High.
